data.gender_notes: Niko is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'nikos,' meaning 'victory.' In ancient Greece, a 'nikos' was a victor in a contest or a conqueror. In Christianity, the name Niko can symbolize the victory of Christ over sin and death. The name Niko carries the meaning “Victory of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Niko usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Niko belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory of the people.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Niko total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: ניקו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ניקו מקורו ביוונית וניקח מהמילה 'ניקא', שפירושה נצחון. בהקשר של השם העברי, ניקו משמעו נצחון עם אלוהים, חזק וגדול. השם ניקו הוא קצר וקולע, וניתן לפרשו כמי שמנצח או מחזק את האל.

in_greek.name: Νίκο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Νίκο προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'Νίκη', που σημαίνει νίκη. Στη Βίβλο, η λέξη 'Νίκη' χρησιμοποιείται για να περιγράψει τη νίκη του Θεού ή των πιστών. Το όνομα Νίκο σημαίνει αυτός που νικά ή είναι νικητής.

in_latin.name: Niko
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Niko originem habet in lingua Graeca, a voce 'Nike', quae victoriam significat. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Niko erat usitatum ad significandum victoriam Dei vel fidelium. Nomen Niko interpretari potest ut victor, triumphator.

in_english.name: Niko
in_english.long_meaning: The name Niko originates from the Greek word 'Nike', meaning victory. Derived from Hebrew and Greek roots, Niko signifies triumph and strength in God. Historically, Niko has been used in Christian tradition to denote a victorious or strong individual. The name connotes spiritual significance, symbolizing faith and resilience.

data.cultural_impact: The name Niko holds a rich cultural history, originating from ancient Greece. Greek mythology is full of gods, and Niko's name was believed to be associated with Nike, the goddess of victory. With a powerful and historic cultural background, the name Niko carries an air of strength and triumph.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Niko serves as a reminder of Christ's ultimate victory over sin and death. By adopting this name, a Christian can be constantly inspired by the idea that, just as Christ emerged victorious, so too can they overcome their own struggles and obstacles. Additionally, Niko can be seen as a testament to God's power and might, highlighting the triumphant nature of the Christian faith.
